name: Fried one-sun mackerel
summary: Cá thu một nắng rán giòn is the salty plate with rice when a Hạ Long table skips the seafood soups. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, also serves it at the Cái Dăm meal.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015.
howToEat: Fried until crisp, with the rice. It sits beside canh rạm, not in the bowl.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The ordinary meal, and the Cái Dăm table. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Ca thu mot nang ran — fried one-sun mackerel
